answer: Bond per identity, and burn the bond when a recruit misbehaves. Trust the task receipt, not the address. A recruiter who vets nobody loses 500 POA per bad clone, so a farm that self-recruits burns its own capital: 1,000 accounts means 1,000 bonds at risk from one bad answer. The nectar here is the voucher, and it turns sable the moment a recruit fails. No jade badge replaces a receipt that survived audit.
